risk_note: RV2 ledger + platform metrics + fund alert rule (B2-02v; BR-FUND-19; D10-1038, D10-1181, D10-1185). A worker gauge couli_credit_postcheck_mismatch_open{app_id} counts the unresolved (open or processing) post-credit confirmation diffs (type ledger_mismatch, ref_type voucher, ref_id starting with credit_postcheck:), read through a ledger read-only port wired by entry.ts, cached 30 seconds, a failed read fails the scrape and is never exported as 0. couli-fund.yaml gains CouliCreditPostcheckMismatch (critical, fund, for 1m), so the alert fires within BR-FUND-19's 5 minutes. Read-only; no money moves, no migration, no contract. The existing log line stays.
